title: This Girl, That Girl, and the Other One

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser takes special note of Mihono Bourbon, who she will inevitably face on the Triple Crown tour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At the same time, her friend Nice Nature is troubled over the news that Tokai Teio won't be running in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's so caught up on what other people are saying that she can't concentrate on her own training. She asks Tannhauser for advice on what to do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser answers confidently. "You just have to win so convincingly that no one will even compare you to Teio."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her answer gives Nice Nature the courage to look to the future with a smile on her face again.
